name: EPIC 246781686
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 11.3 solar radii and 1.29 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,470 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.29 solar masses and 11.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,964 K at its surface.
